# Punnagai Toy Store (புன்னகை டாய்ஸ் & ஃபேன்சி)
> Mylapore's favourite toy store in Chennai, offering 500+ quality toys for every age, from newborns to teenagers.

## Store Overview
- **Name**: Punnagai Toy Store (Punnagai Toys & Fancy)
- **Store Address**: 4/7 Luz Bazar Complex, R.K. Mutt Road, Mylapore, Chennai – 600 004, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Landmark**: Inside Luz Bazar, near Luz Corner, Mylapore
- **Official Website**: https://punnagaitoysfancy.in
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 75501 32101 / +91 72994 61657
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM | Sunday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- **Price Range**: ₹₹ (Affordable, transparent pricing)

## What We Offer
- **Baby & Infant Toys (0–2 Years)**: BPA-free silicone teethers, musical rattles, sensory plush, soft cloth books, tummy-time mats.
- **Toddler Toys (3–5 Years)**: Wooden Montessori blocks, peg puzzles, magnetic drawing boards, balance bikes, play-dough sets.
- **Kids Toys (6–8 Years)**: STEM building sets, remote-controlled cars, science experiment kits, classic Indian board games, Lego-compatible bricks.
- **Tweens & Teens (9+ Years)**: Strategy board games, 3D mechanical wooden puzzles, robotics kits, art and craft hampers.
- **Return Gifts & Birthday Party Packs**: Bulk return gifts for birthday parties, school celebrations, and festive occasions with custom packaging and volume discounts.

## Services & Delivery
- **In-Store Shopping**: Walk-in retail store with hands-on toy demonstrations in Mylapore.
- **WhatsApp 1-Click Ordering**: Reserve any product online and chat directly with store owners for instant booking.
- **Chennai Same-Day Delivery**: Fast doorstep delivery across Chennai (Mylapore, Mandaveli, Alwarpet, Santhome, R.A. Puram, T. Nagar, Adyar, Velachery, Anna Nagar).
- **Tamil Nadu Courier Shipping**: Fast shipping across Tamil Nadu.
- **Free Shipping**: Orders above ₹999 qualify for free shipping.
- **Payment Methods Accepted**: Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking.
